zh.title: 木村拓哉之女擔任星宇航空大使 張國煒親自導覽空山基藝術機
zh.summary: 星宇航空邀請木村拓哉之女Kōki,任藝術機大使；董事長張國煒親自導覽
body: 星宇航空日前宣布與日本藝術家空山基合作，推出「STARLUX AIRSORAYAMA」藝術計畫，以旗艦機型空中巴士A350-1000打造兩架獨特的藝術機。此計畫包含兩款特別塗裝，分別為「空山金」與「空山銀」藝術機。為了推廣此項結合航空美學與現代藝術的合作，星宇航空特別邀請日本藝人木村拓哉的女兒Kōki,擔任計畫的藝術機宣傳大使。
根據星宇航空發布的新聞稿，Kōki,日前抵達桃園國際機場（TPE）後，隨即前往星宇航空位於機場的航機修護棚廠，親自一睹「空山銀」藝術機的風采。在參觀過程中，星宇航空董事長張國煒親自現身接待並進行導覽。張國煒向Kōki,分享了AIRSORAYAMA計畫從最初構想到實現的完整歷程，並詳細介紹空山基標誌性的金屬美學與設計元素，如何與星宇航空的品牌精神進行融合。
Kōki,表示，先前在拍攝該計畫的宣傳影片時，只能藉由想像來感受AIRSORAYAMA藝術機的設計，今日終於能親自站在實體飛機旁，感覺非常感動。她表示這是一架結合藝術、設計與航空夢想的作品，很榮幸能成為其中的一部分。

根據本站歷史資料庫，星宇航空與空山基合作的兩架A350-1000客機均已順利交機，機上配置共350個座位。第一架「空山銀」（機身編號B-58553）已於2026年7月交機，並於7月12日首航東京；第二架「空山金」（機身編號B-58554）則是在法國時間8月14日完成交機，並於8月16日返抵桃園國際機場。星宇航空表示，這兩架藝術機預計將自2026年10月1日起正式投入定期航班營運，並將飛航東京、鳳凰城及布拉格等國際熱門航線。

en.title: STARLUX Airlines Appoints Kōki, as Art Plane Ambassador with Hangar Tour by Chairman
en.summary: STARLUX Airlines appoints Kōki, as art plane ambassador during a hangar tour in Taiwan
body: STARLUX Airlines announced on August 27, 2026, the launch of its "STARLUX AIRSORAYAMA" art project, a unique collaboration with renowned Japanese artist Hajime Sorayama. The project features two specially designed Airbus A350-1000 flagship aircraft, themed as "AIRSORAYAMA GOLD" and "AIRSORAYAMA SILVER" respectively. To celebrate the debut of these artistic aircraft, STARLUX Airlines has appointed Kōki,, the daughter of famous Japanese actor Takuya Kimura, as the official project ambassador.

According to a press release from STARLUX Airlines, Kōki, recently arrived at Taoyuan International Airport (TPE) and visited the airline's aircraft maintenance hangar to inspect the "AIRSORAYAMA SILVER" aircraft. During her visit, STARLUX Airlines Chairman K.W. Chang made a personal appearance to welcome the ambassador and guide her through the aircraft. Chang shared the conceptual journey of the AIRSORAYAMA project from its inception to final realization, highlighting how Sorayama's iconic metallic aesthetics and futuristic elements were seamlessly integrated with the corporate brand identity of STARLUX Airlines.

Reflecting on her experience, Kōki, expressed deep gratitude, noting that during the filming of the promotional video, she could only imagine the aesthetic impact of the project. Seeing the actual aircraft in person, she felt deeply moved and honored to be a part of a creation that combines art, engineering design, and aviation dreams.

According to AVWIRE historical records, the two flagship A350-1000 aircraft feature a 350-seat configuration, including four First Class seats, 40 Business Class seats, 36 Premium Economy seats, and 270 Economy Class seats. The first art plane, "AIRSORAYAMA SILVER" (registration B-58553), was delivered in July 2026 and completed its inaugural flight to Tokyo on July 12. The second aircraft, "AIRSORAYAMA GOLD" (registration B-58554), completed its delivery in France on August 14 and arrived at Taoyuan International Airport on August 16. The airline plans to deploy both art planes into regular commercial service starting October 1, 2026, on routes serving Tokyo, Phoenix, and Prague.

zh.title: 立法院會處理無人機條例草案 朝野就預算編列尚無共識
zh.summary: 立法院會27日處理無人機條例草案；民眾黨主張視需求由行政院逐年編列預算
body: 立法院會於2026年8月27日排定處理無人機條例草案。先前立法院長韓國瑜召集朝野協商，民進黨團主張特別條例，國民黨團與民眾黨團堅持年度預算編列，國民黨團提出6年共新台幣2400億元，朝野未達共識。
民眾黨立法院黨團總召陳清龍說明黨版草案，主張成立無人載具戰略特別委員會制定發展綱領，預算由行政院依產業需求與財政狀況逐年編列，由立法院監督審查。
本站歷史紀錄顯示，立法院曾於2026年8月20日就無人載具條例草案進行協商，當時因朝野就法案名稱與經費上限等未獲共識，宣告全案保留。

en.title: Taiwan Lawmakers Process Drone Act Draft Amid Budget Disagreements
en.summary: Taiwan's Legislative Yuan processes the drone bill draft; parties remain split over budget structure
body: Taiwan's Legislative Yuan scheduled consideration of draft drone legislation on August 27, 2026. Legislative Speaker Han Kuo-yu convened party consultations, where the Democratic Progressive Party caucus advocated a special statute while the Kuomintang and Taiwan People's Party insisted on annual budget allocation. Kuomintang lawmakers proposed allocating NT$240 billion over six years, but no consensus was reached.

Chen Ching-long of the Taiwan People's Party outlined their proposal to establish a strategic committee for unmanned vehicles to set development guidelines. Under this plan, the Executive Yuan would compile annual budgets based on industry needs for legislative review.
Official archives show lawmakers previously held consultations on the draft act on August 20, 2026, which ended without agreement on funding caps and legislative details.

zh.title: 達美航空9月起重返特拉維夫 採用A330-900neo執飛
zh.summary: 達美航空9月6日起恢復紐約至特拉維夫每日服務；採用A330-900neo客機執飛。
body: 達美航空（Delta Air Lines）計畫於9月重返特拉維夫，自9月6日起恢復從紐約出發的每日航班服務，並將採用空中巴士A330-900neo客機執行營運。
根據資料紀錄，達美航空新引進的空中巴士A330-900neo機型配備56套 Delta One 套房客艙佈局，專門針對熱門跨大西洋航線設計與部署。
隨著航班營運預計於9月6日啟動，達美航空將透過空中巴士A330-900neo客機正式恢復紐約與特拉維夫之間的每日往返航班服務。

en.title: Delta Air Lines To Resume New York-Tel Aviv Flights In September With Airbus A330-900neo
en.summary: Delta Air Lines will resume daily New York-Tel Aviv flights on September 6 using Airbus A330-900neo aircraft.
body: Delta Air Lines plans to return to Tel Aviv in September, deploying Airbus A330-900neo aircraft on the route. The carrier will resume daily services connecting New York and Tel Aviv starting September 6.

Delta's new Airbus A330-900neo aircraft feature a premium-heavy cabin layout equipped with 56 Delta One suites. This interior configuration is targeted primarily at top transatlantic routes across the carrier's international long-haul network.

With flight operations scheduled to start on September 6, Delta will re-establish its daily passenger service between New York and Tel Aviv using the Airbus A330-900neo aircraft to serve international travelers.

zh.title: 新低成本品牌Fly2Galicia擬於12月開航 採用濕租模式營運
zh.summary: Fly2Galicia計畫12月開航；採FLYYO濕租營運；連結聖地亞哥與歐洲8航點。
body: 西班牙低成本航空新品牌Fly2Galicia計畫於2026年12月1日正式開航，營運基地設於西班牙西北部聖地亞哥–德孔波斯特拉的羅薩利亞·德·卡斯特羅機場（SCQ）。該品牌由Aviation & Mobility Services Group負責行銷與航線開發，旨在提升加利西亞地區前往歐洲主要城市與商業中心之直飛空中交通效益。
根據營運規劃，Fly2Galicia初期不會自行執行航班，而是透過濕租協議由羅馬尼亞航空公司FLYYO負責實際飛航業務。該公司規劃航網包含8個西班牙國內及歐洲航點，涵蓋國內線的阿利坎特、格拉納達與薩拉戈薩，以及布魯塞爾、米蘭、威尼斯、慕尼黑和布拉格等國際航點。

en.title: Fly2Galicia Plans December Launch from Santiago de Compostela Under Wet-Lease Agreement
en.summary: Fly2Galicia plans to launch operations from Santiago de Compostela in December using wet-leased aircraft from FLYYO.
body: New budget airline brand Fly2Galicia is scheduled to launch operations on 1 December 2026 from Rosalia de Castro Airport (SCQ) in Santiago de Compostela, northwestern Spain. Marketed by Aviation & Mobility Services Group, the carrier aims to enhance direct regional air connectivity between Galicia and major European business and leisure hubs.

Under the operational setup, Fly2Galicia will not operate the flights directly. Instead, Romanian airline FLYYO will execute the flight operations under a wet-lease agreement. The initial network encompasses eight destinations across Spain and Europe, including domestic routes to Alicante, Granada, and Zaragoza, as well as international services to Brussels, Milan, Venice, Munich, and Prague.

zh.title: 英國民航局公布第二季旅客人數創新高 廉航成長抵銷中東航線下滑
zh.summary: 英國機場第二季旅客達8116萬人次；廉航運量增加；中東航線客流下滑
body: 英國民航局（CAA）於2026年8月27日公布最新資料指出，英國各機場在2026年4月至6月（第二季）期間共處理8116萬人次的旅客人數，創下歷年同期最高紀錄。雖然總客流量相較2025年同期僅微幅增加12萬人次，增幅約為0.15%，但整體客源結構與航線分布出現顯著轉變。

在航空公司表現方面，廉價航空成為推動英國客運成長的主要力量。瑞安航空（Ryanair）在第二季處理1710萬人次，較去年同期成長9%；易捷航空（easyJet）客運量成長2%至1640萬人次；Jet2亦成長9%達到670萬人次。這三家廉價航空公司合計增加225萬名旅客，遠超過英國整體市場的淨增長量。在航班起降架次上，瑞安航空增加約9000架次，易捷航空增加約4000架次，Jet2則增加約2000架次。相對地，英國航空（British Airways）減少約2000架次起降，TUI Airways亦減少約1000架次。

受地緣政治衝突與空域受限影響，中東航線客運量大幅下滑。其中，阿聯酋航空（Emirates）在英國機場的載客人數年減46%，卡達航空（Qatar Airways）亦減少42%。杜拜航線旅客總數下降50%至約73.6萬人次。中東地區的下滑促使旅客轉向歐洲短途目的地，西歐航線增加約100萬名旅客，英國國內線增加約30萬人次，東歐航線則增加約20萬人次。熱門城市如馬德里旅客數成長15%、巴塞隆納成長11%、阿利坎特成長8%、法羅成長7%，都柏林則成長5%。
儘管總旅客人數創下新高，英國航班的營運準點表現卻有所惡化。第二季僅有74%的航班在預定時間15分鐘內起飛或降落，低於去年同期的75%。平均延誤時間從13分鐘增加至14分鐘，而在起飛前24小時內遭取消的航班比例亦上升至0.91%。整體資料顯示，英國航空市場在中東局勢動盪下仍保持成長，但營運效率與準點率均面臨挑戰。

en.title: UK Airport Passenger Numbers Hit Record in Q2 2026 as Budget Carriers Offset Middle East Decline
en.summary: UK airports handled record Q2 passengers as low-cost growth offset Middle East traffic declines.
body: Official data released by the UK Civil Aviation Authority on August 27, 2026, shows that UK airports handled a record 81.16 million passengers between April and June 2026 (Q2). Although the quarterly total represents a slight net increase of around 120,000 passengers—up 0.15% compared to the same period in 2025—the underlying market dynamics shifted significantly toward low-cost carriers and European short-haul routes amid geopolitical disruption in the Middle East.

Low-cost airlines drove the majority of passenger growth across UK airports during the second quarter. Ryanair recorded a 9% year-on-year increase, carrying 17.1 million passengers, while Jet2 also grew 9% to reach 6.7 million passengers. easyJet, the second-largest UK airport operator by volume, expanded passenger traffic by 2% to 16.4 million. Combined, these three carriers handled 2.25 million additional passengers compared to Q2 2025. In terms of flight activity, Ryanair operated roughly 9,000 additional air transport movements, easyJet added approximately 4,000, and Jet2 added around 2,000, while British Airways and TUI Airways reduced operations by approximately 2,000 and 1,000 movements, respectively.

Conversely, carriers and routes exposed to Middle East airspace disruption recorded substantial declines. Emirates carried 46% fewer passengers through UK airports during the quarter, and Qatar Airways recorded a 42% drop. Overall traffic on the Dubai route plummeted 50% year-on-year to approximately 736,000 passengers. Demand redirected primarily to European destinations, with Western Europe generating 1 million additional UK passengers, domestic flying adding 300,000, and Eastern Europe increasing by 200,000. Key European city and leisure destinations showed notable gains, including Madrid up 15%, Barcelona up 11%, Alicante up 8%, Faro up 7%, and Dublin up 5%.

The record passenger throughput was accompanied by deterioration in operational reliability across UK airports. Only 74% of flights arrived or departed within 15 minutes of schedule during Q2 2026, down from 75% in the prior-year period. Average flight delays rose from 13 minutes to 14 minutes, while the rate of flights cancelled within 24 hours of departure increased to 0.91%.

zh.title: 澳洲航安會就雪梨機場（SYD）兩起新事件展開調查
zh.summary: 航安會調查8/16滑行道衝突及8/25推回衝突；已有四起其他事件調查中
body: 澳洲運輸安全局（ATSB）已針對雪梨機場發生的兩起新事件展開調查，分別涉及8月16日澳洲航空與維珍澳洲航空的滑行道衝突，以及8月25日捷星航空空中巴士A320的推回過程衝突。
根據ATSB報告，8月16日維珍澳洲航空VA1589航班（波音737，註冊號VH-IXJ）改降雪梨後在滑行道B滑行，同時澳洲航空QF420航班（波音737，註冊號VH-VZV）從跑道16R經滑行道B8離場。管制指示維珍機組讓路，但維珍機組讀回錯誤且未被管制員察覺，導致雙機接近，最終澳洲航空機組停機並澄清滑行順序。
8月25日，捷星航空VH-VFX空中巴士A320準備從雪梨飛往朗塞斯敦時，管制員據報未向機組提供完整交通資訊，導致推回組未獲知身後有飛機滑行，推回組發現衝突後中止推回並將飛機拉回機位。ATSB將此歸類為「未傳遞交通資訊」。
這兩起新調查加上先前已在進行的四起雪梨機場事件（含一起空服員受傷事件），顯示澳洲最繁忙機場的地面移動與管制資訊流程受到關注。ATSB表示各調查獨立進行但團隊將協調，視證據可能擴大或合併調查。
ATSB預計在六至八周內發布初步報告，但調查可能要到明年才結束。另已在調查8月9日發生的跑道闖入事件，當時維珍澳洲航空VA555起飛滑跑時發現澳洲航空737從滑行道L穿越跑道34L，維珍機組拒絕起飛並停在跑道上。

en.title: ATSB opens two new investigations into Sydney Airport (SYD) incidents
en.summary: ATSB investigating August 16 taxiway conflict and August 25 pushback incident; four other Sydney Airport probes ongoing
body: The Australian Transport Safety Bureau (ATSB) has opened two new investigations into incidents at Sydney Airport (SYD), involving a taxiway conflict between Virgin Australia and Qantas on August 16 and a pushback incident involving a Jetstar Airbus A320 on August 25.

According to the ATSB, on August 16 Virgin Australia flight VA1589 (Boeing 737, registration VH-IXJ) diverted to Sydney and was taxiing north on taxiway B, while Qantas flight QF420 (Boeing 737, registration VH-VZV) was vacating runway 16R via taxiway B8. Air traffic control instructed the Virgin crew to give way, but the instruction was not correctly read back and the incorrect readback was not identified by the controller. The Qantas crew saw the Virgin 737 approaching, stopped, and both crews clarified the taxi sequence.

On August 25, Jetstar Airbus A320 VH-VFX was preparing for pushback for a flight to Launceston when the controller allegedly failed to provide complete traffic information to the crew, who would need to relay it to the tug team. The pilots were not told about another aircraft taxiing behind the A320. The pushback crew identified the conflict, stopped the manoeuvre, and returned the aircraft to its stand. The ATSB described the event as a "failure to pass traffic".

The two new investigations add to four other ongoing probes at Sydney Airport, including an event where a flight attendant was injured. The ATSB said the investigations are being conducted separately, though teams will coordinate, and depending on evidence they could be expanded or combined.

The regulator expects to publish preliminary reports within six to eight weeks, although investigations are not likely to conclude until next year. The ATSB is also investigating a runway incursion on August 9, when Virgin Australia flight VA555 rejected takeoff on runway 34L after a Qantas 737 crossed the runway from taxiway Lima.
